# Clock fonts

Cornerwork includes numeric-only subsets of these Google Fonts for the workout timer:

- League Spartan, weight 900: https://fonts.google.com/specimen/League+Spartan
- Montserrat, weight 900: https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Montserrat
- Barlow Condensed, weight 900: https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Barlow+Condensed
- Allerta Stencil, regular: https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Allerta+Stencil
- Keania One, regular: https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Keania+One

League Spartan, Montserrat, and Barlow Condensed contain only digits `0` through `9` and the colon. Allerta Stencil and Keania One are included as their original, unmodified font files. The fonts are licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. Their license files are included in the `licenses` directory.
